  55 class ClaimBank:
  56     """Arguments for one case. `pkg` is the data package (or None); the case's own `facts` win."""
  57 
  58     def __init__(self, pkg, case):
  59         self.pkg, self.case = pkg, case
  60         self.facts = case.get("facts") or {}
  61         self.refs = list(case.get("refs") or [])
  62         # a case whose refs the package does not know (the sandbox's demo world)
  63         self.foreign = bool(self.refs) and pkg is not None and not any(pkg.lookup(r) for r in self.refs)
  64 
  65     def fact(self, ref):
  66         if ref in self.facts:
  67             return self.facts[ref]
  68         return None if self.foreign or self.pkg is None else self.pkg.lookup(ref)
  69 
  70     def ids(self, prefix):
  71         out = set() if self.foreign or self.pkg is None else set(self.pkg.ids(prefix))
  72         out |= {k for k in self.facts if k.startswith(prefix)}
  73         out |= {r for r in self.refs if r.startswith(prefix)}
  74         return sorted(out)
  75 
  76     def query(self, sql, params=()):
  77         if self.foreign or self.pkg is None:
  78             return []
  79         try:
  80             return self.pkg.query(sql, params)
  81         except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - a package without SQLite: facts only
  82             return []
  83 
  84     # -- single arguments ------------------------------------------------------------------
  85     def should_cost(self, part, sid, quote):
  86         best = None
  87         for ref in self.ids("cost:"):
  88             f = self.fact(ref)
  89             if not f or f.get("part") != part or not f.get("unit_cost"):
  90                 continue
  91             if ref.endswith("-" + sid.split(":")[-1]):
  92                 best = (ref, f)
  93                 break
  94             if best is None and "-" not in ref.split(":")[-1]:
  95                 best = (ref, f)
  96         if not best:
  97             return None
  98         ref, f = best
  99         if quote and f["unit_cost"] >= quote * 0.98:
 100             return None  # above or near its price: argues its case
 101         return {
 102             "kind": "should_cost",
 103             "ids": [ref],
 104             "text": f"Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is {money(f['unit_cost'])} per unit ({ref}).",
 105             "strength": 5,
 106         }
 107 
 108     def order_history(self, part, sid, quote):
 109         rows = self.query(
 110             "SELECT id FROM po_lines WHERE part_id = ? AND supplier_id = ? ORDER BY order_date DESC LIMIT 3",
 111             (part, sid),
 112         )
 113         facts = [(r["id"], self.fact(r["id"])) for r in rows]
 114         facts = [(i, f) for i, f in facts if f and f.get("unit_price")]
 115         if len(facts) < 2:
 116             return None
 117         prices = [f["unit_price"] for _, f in facts]
 118         unit = per_unit(facts[0][1])
 119         if quote and min(prices) / unit >= quote:
 120             return None  # the figure stays as recorded (per 100 or 1000 where priced so): that is what is checked
 121         ids = [i for i, _ in facts]
 122         each = f" per {unit} units" if unit != 1 else ""
 123         if len(set(prices)) == 1:
 124             text = f"Our last {len(ids)} orders for this part were at {money(prices[0])}{each} ({', '.join(ids)})."
 125         else:
 126             listed = " and ".join(money(p) for p in prices)
 127             text = f"Our last orders for this part were at {listed}{each} ({', '.join(ids)})."
 128         return {"kind": "order_history", "ids": ids, "text": text, "strength": 4}
 129 
 130     def notice(self, sid):
 131         doc = self.case.get("trigger_doc")
 132         f = self.fact(doc) if doc else None
 133         if not f or f.get("days") is None:
 134             return None
 135         ctr = next((r for r in self.refs if r.startswith("ctr:") and "#" not in r), None)
 136         c = self.fact(ctr) if ctr else None
 137         if not c or c.get("days") is None or f["days"] >= c["days"]:
 138             return None
 139         text = (
 140             f"Your letter gives {f['days']} days' notice ({doc}); our agreement provides for {c['days']} days ({ctr})."
 141         )
 142         return {"kind": "notice", "ids": [doc, ctr], "text": text, "strength": 5}
 143 
 144     def move12(self, series):
 145         """The series' change over the last twelve months as a share (what suppliers cite), or None."""
 146         ids = self.ids(f"idx:{series}@")
 147         if not ids:
 148             return None
 149         m2 = ids[-1].split("@")[-1]
 150         a, b = self.fact(f"idx:{series}@{months_back(m2, 12)}"), self.fact(ids[-1])
 151         if not a or not b or not a.get("value") or not b.get("value"):
 152             return None
 153         return b["value"] / a["value"] - 1
 154 
 155     def index_change(self, series):
 156         """The largest fall of a series over any window of up to 12 months ending at its latest
 157         month (the window the arena checks). AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months but fell 5.5 %
 158         from June to September 2026: the second is the argument the distributors "take into
 159         account", the first would argue their case."""
 160         ids = self.ids(f"idx:{series}@")
 161         if not ids:
 162             return None
 163         m2 = ids[-1].split("@")[-1]
 164         b = self.fact(ids[-1])
 165         if not b or not b.get("value"):
 166             return None
 167         best = None
 168         for back in range(1, 13):
 169             m1 = months_back(m2, back)
 170             a = self.fact(f"idx:{series}@{m1}")
 171             if not a or not a.get("value"):
 172                 continue
 173             pct = (b["value"] / a["value"] - 1) * 100
 174             if best is None or pct < best[0]:
 175                 best = (pct, m1)
 176         if best is None or best[0] > -0.5:
 177             return None  # a rising driver confirms the supplier's case
 178         pct, m1 = best
 179         name = SERIES_NAME.get(series, f"The index {series}")
 180         return {
 181             "kind": "index",
 182             "ids": [f"idx:{series}@{m1}", f"idx:{series}@{m2}"],
 183             "text": f"{name} changed {pct:.1f}% from {m1} to {m2} (idx:{series}@{m1}, idx:{series}@{m2}).",
 184             "strength": 4 + min(3.0, abs(pct) / 2),  # a falling driver outranks notes and orders
 185         }
 186 
 187     def drivers(self, part):
 188         return [r["series_id"] for r in self.query("SELECT series_id FROM cost_drivers WHERE part_id = ?", (part,))]
 189 
 190     def forecast(self, part):
 191         ids = self.ids(f"fc:{part.split(':')[-1]}@")
 192         f = self.fact(ids[-1]) if ids else None
 193         if not f or (f.get("change_pct") or 0) <= 0:
 194             return None
 195         text = f"Our forecast for this part is up {f['change_pct']:.1f}% ({ids[-1]})."
 196         return {"kind": "forecast", "ids": [ids[-1]], "text": text, "strength": 2}
 197 
 198     def rival_quote(self, part, sid, price):
 199         """A quote of this case from another supplier, cheaper than this supplier's price."""
 200         out = []
 201         for ref in self.refs:
 202             f = self.fact(ref) if ref.startswith("quote:") else None
 203             if not f or f.get("part") != part or f.get("supplier") == sid or not price or not f.get("unit_price"):
 204                 continue
 205             unit = per_unit(f)
 206             if f["unit_price"] / unit < price:
 207                 each = f"per {unit} units" if unit != 1 else "per unit"
 208                 out.append(
 209                     {
 210                         "kind": "rival",
 211                         "ids": [ref],
 212                         "text": f"We hold another quote for this part at {money(f['unit_price'])} {each} ({ref}).",
 213                         "strength": 6,
 214                         "rival": True,
 215                     }
 216                 )
 217         return out
 218 
 219     def signal_notes(self, sid):
 220         """Its own words in our notes that weaken its case: material bought forward at fixed prices,
 221         an offer to open its calculation. Context for the person reading, not a checked figure."""
 222         out = []
 223         for d in self.query(
 224             "SELECT id, date, kind, file FROM documents WHERE supplier_id = ? ORDER BY date DESC", (sid,)
 225         ):
 226             path = self.pkg.root / (d.get("file") or "") if self.pkg else None
 227             text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") if path and path.is_file() else ""
 228             if re.search(r"covered at fixed prices|bought their \w+ forward|material covered until", text, re.I):
 229                 out.append(
 230                     {
 231                         "kind": "hedged",
 232                         "ids": [d["id"]],
 233                         "text": f"Your letter of {d['date']} ({d['id']}) says your material is covered at fixed "
 234                         "prices, so recent index movements do not reach your costs yet.",
 235                         "strength": 5,
 236                     }
 237                 )
 238             if re.search(r"walk us through their calculation", text, re.I):
 239                 out.append(
 240                     {
 241                         "kind": "open_book",
 242                         "ids": [d["id"]],
 243                         "text": f"In our call of {d['date']} ({d['id']}) you offered to walk us through your "
 244                         "calculation; we would welcome that now.",
 245                         "strength": 4,
 246                     }
 247                 )
 248         seen, uniq = set(), []
 249         for c in out:
 250             if c["kind"] not in seen:
 251                 seen.add(c["kind"])
 252                 uniq.append(c)
 253         return uniq
 254 
 255     def scorecard(self, sid, quality):
 256         ids = self.ids(f"sc:{sid.split(':')[-1]}@")
 257         if not ids:
 258             return None
 259         f = self.fact(ids[-1])
 260         if f is None:  # demo world: cite without a figure
 261             text = f"We have reviewed your delivery performance in our supplier scorecard ({ids[-1]})."
 262             return {"kind": "scorecard", "ids": [ids[-1]], "text": text, "strength": 2}
 263         quarter = f.get("quarter") or ids[-1].split("@")[-1]
 264         if quality:
 265             if (f.get("ppm") or 0) < 1000:
 266                 return None
 267             text = f"Your deliveries ran at {f['ppm']} ppm in {quarter} ({ids[-1]})."
 268         else:
 269             if (f.get("otd_pct") or 100) >= 90:
 270                 return None
 271             text = f"Your on-time delivery was {f['otd_pct']}% in {quarter} ({ids[-1]})."
 272         return {"kind": "scorecard", "ids": [ids[-1]], "text": text, "strength": 2}
 273 
 274     def demo_refs(self):
 275         """Refs the package cannot resolve: cited without a figure."""
 276         words = {
 277             "cost": ("should_cost", "Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is on file ({ids}).", 5),
 278             "po": ("order_history", "We compared your offer with our recent order prices for this part ({ids}).", 4),
 279         }
 280         out = []
 281         for kind, (name, text, strength) in words.items():
 282             ids = [r for r in self.refs if r.startswith(f"{kind}:") and self.fact(r) is None]
 283             if ids:
 284                 out.append(
 285                     {"kind": name, "ids": ids[:3], "text": text.format(ids=", ".join(ids[:3])), "strength": strength}
 286                 )
 287         doc = self.case.get("trigger_doc")
 288         ctr = next((r for r in self.refs if r.startswith("ctr:")), None)
 289         if doc and ctr and self.fact(doc) is None and self.case.get("type") == "price_increase":
 290             text = f"Your letter ({doc}) gives less notice than our agreement provides for ({ctr})."
 291             out.append({"kind": "notice", "ids": [doc, ctr], "text": text, "strength": 5})
 292         return out
 293 
 294     # -- per supplier ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 295     def for_supplier(self, sid, quote):
 296         """Every argument for this supplier that pushes our way, strongest first."""
 297         case, out = self.case, []
 298         quality = case.get("type") == "quality" or case["buyer"].get("category_goal") == "quality_first"
 299         single = len(case.get("parts") or []) == 1  # a bundle's price is not one part's order price
 300         for part in case.get("parts") or []:
 301             history = self.order_history(part, sid, quote) if single else None
 302             out += [c for c in (self.should_cost(part, sid, quote), history) if c]
 303             out += [c for c in (self.index_change(s) for s in self.drivers(part)) if c]
 304             out += self.rival_quote(part, sid, quote)
 305             if c := self.forecast(part):
 306                 out.append(c)
 307         if c := self.notice(sid):
 308             out.append(c)
 309         out += self.signal_notes(sid)
 310         if c := self.scorecard(sid, quality):

  35 def months_back(month, n):

  55 class ClaimBank:

  58     def __init__(self, pkg, case):

  70     def ids(self, prefix):

  73         out |= {r for r in self.refs if r.startswith(prefix)}

  76     def query(self, sql, params=()):

  85     def should_cost(self, part, sid, quote):

 130     def notice(self, sid):

 136         c = self.fact(ctr) if ctr else None

 138             return None

 144     def move12(self, series):
 145         """The series' change over the last twelve months as a share (what suppliers cite), or None."""
 146         ids = self.ids(f"idx:{series}@")
 147         if not ids:
 148             return None
 149         m2 = ids[-1].split("@")[-1]
 150         a, b = self.fact(f"idx:{series}@{months_back(m2, 12)}"), self.fact(ids[-1])
 151         if not a or not b or not a.get("value") or not b.get("value"):
 152             return None

 155     def index_change(self, series):
 156         """The largest fall of a series over any window of up to 12 months ending at its latest
 157         month (the window the arena checks). AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months but fell 5.5 %
 158         from June to September 2026: the second is the argument the distributors "take into
 159         account", the first would argue their case."""
 160         ids = self.ids(f"idx:{series}@")
 161         if not ids:
 162             return None
 163         m2 = ids[-1].split("@")[-1]
 164         b = self.fact(ids[-1])
 165         if not b or not b.get("value"):
 166             return None
 167         best = None
 168         for back in range(1, 13):
 169             m1 = months_back(m2, back)
 170             a = self.fact(f"idx:{series}@{m1}")
 171             if not a or not a.get("value"):
 172                 continue
 173             pct = (b["value"] / a["value"] - 1) * 100
 174             if best is None or pct < best[0]:
 175                 best = (pct, m1)
 176         if best is None or best[0] > -0.5:
 177             return None  # a rising driver confirms the supplier's case
 178         pct, m1 = best
 179         name = SERIES_NAME.get(series, f"The index {series}")
 180         return {
 181             "kind": "index",
 182             "ids": [f"idx:{series}@{m1}", f"idx:{series}@{m2}"],
 183             "text": f"{name} changed {pct:.1f}% from {m1} to {m2} (idx:{series}@{m1}, idx:{series}@{m2}).",
 184             "strength": 4 + min(3.0, abs(pct) / 2),  # a falling driver outranks notes and orders

 198     def rival_quote(self, part, sid, price):

 263         quarter = f.get("quarter") or ids[-1].split("@")[-1]

 278             "po": ("order_history", "We compared your offer with our recent order prices for this part ({ids}).", 4),
 279         }
 280         out = []

 282             ids = [r for r in self.refs if r.startswith(f"{kind}:") and self.fact(r) is None]
 283             if ids:
 284                 out.append(

1 """The published cost function: what a term sheet costs the buyer in €, plus term helpers.
   2 
   3 C covers the buyer's fixed need over a fixed horizon: need the deal does not cover is bought at
   4 the case's fallback price (plus the fallback risk of the category goal), committed volume is bought
   5 needed or not, and units bought before a new price takes effect cost the current price. In
   6 strategic and bottleneck cases a deal that leaves the supplier below a sustainable margin costs
   7 too - pass your estimate of the supplier (`supplier_value`) to price that. Do the arithmetic here,
   8 not in the language model.
   9 """
  10 
  11 import math
  12 import operator
  13 from datetime import date
  14 
  15 # Strategic and bottleneck goals: leaving the supplier below a sustainable margin costs.
  16 RELATIONSHIP_GOALS = {"stabilise", "secure_supply"}
  17 OPS = {
  18     "<=": operator.le,
  19     "<": operator.lt,
  20     ">=": operator.ge,
  21     ">": operator.gt,
  22     "==": operator.eq,
  23     "!=": operator.ne,
  24 }
  25 
  26 
  27 def closing_terms(case, terms, standard=None):
  28     """The terms a deal would close on: the term sheet, then the supplier's standard terms (from
  29     its quote PDF) for anything left out, then the case's fixed terms; gaps from the buyer's plan.
  30     """
  31     b = case["buyer"]
  32     freight = b["freight_eur_per_unit"]
  33     plan = {
  34         "volume_per_year": b["need_per_year"],
  35         "contract_months": round(12 * b["horizon_years"]),
  36         "payment_days": b["reference_payment_days"],
  37         "lead_time_days": b["need_lead_time_days"],
  38         # an unknown Incoterm counts as the costliest: a cautious buyer does not assume DAP
  39         "incoterm": max(freight, key=freight.get),
  40     }
  41     t = dict(plan)
  42     for layer in (standard or {}, case.get("fixed_terms", {}), terms):
  43         t.update({k: v for k, v in layer.items() if v is not None or k not in plan})
  44     return t
  45 
  46 
  47 def horizon_start(case):
  48     """The horizon starts at the fixed or the earliest possible effective date."""
  49     fixed = case.get("fixed_terms", {}).get("effective_date")
  50     options = [o for o in case.get("term_options", {}).get("effective_date", []) if o]
  51     first = fixed or (min(options) if options else None)
  52     return date.fromisoformat(first) if first else None
  53 
  54 
  55 def _years(case, t):
  56     """Years of the horizon a deal covers; a single order (0 months) counts as one year's lot.
  57     A commitment beyond the horizon neither costs nor earns."""
  58     months = t["contract_months"]
  59     return min(months / 12 if months else 1.0, case["buyer"]["horizon_years"])
  60 
  61 
  62 def _units_before(case, t, years):
  63     """Units bought between the horizon start and the date a new price takes effect."""
  64     start = horizon_start(case)
  65     if not t.get("effective_date") or start is None:
  66         return 0.0
  67     lag = (date.fromisoformat(t["effective_date"]) - start).days / 365
  68     return t["volume_per_year"] * min(max(lag, 0.0), years)
  69 
  70 
  71 def supplier_value(case, terms, supplier):
  72     """What a deal is worth to the supplier per unit, in cash: the price at its standard terms that
  73     would pay it the same. `supplier` is your estimate of it:
  74       standard       its standard terms (quote PDF, `docs.standard_terms`)
  75       interest_rate  what money now is worth to it per year (more to a supplier short of cash)
  76       usual_rate     its usual cost of money (default: interest_rate); tooling paid up front is
  77                      worth more to it when cash is dearer than usual
  78       ppm            the defect rate it really achieves (default: its standard ppm commitment)
  79       extra          EUR per unit it gains (+) or spends (-) beyond these items, e.g. overtime for
  80                      a faster delivery or idle capacity a larger volume fills (default 0)
  81     Contract length and an index clause are security, not cash: they do not count here."""
  82     b, std = case["buyer"], {**supplier["standard"], **case.get("fixed_terms", {})}
  83     t = closing_terms(case, terms, std)
  84     years = _years(case, t)
  85     sold = t["volume_per_year"] * years
  86     old = _units_before(case, t, years) / sold  # sold at the current price
  87     rate = supplier["interest_rate"]
  88     pay = 1 - rate * (t["payment_days"] - std["payment_days"]) / 360
  89     cash_now = 1 + (rate - supplier.get("usual_rate", rate)) * years / 2
  90     freight = b["freight_eur_per_unit"]
  91     ppm = supplier.get("ppm", std.get("ppm_commitment") or 0)
  92     return (
  93         t["unit_price"] * (1 - old) * pay
  94         + old * (b.get("current_unit_price") or 0.0) * pay
  95         + freight[t["incoterm"]]
  96         - freight[std["incoterm"]]  # it carries the freight leg
  97         + ((t.get("tooling_eur") or 0) - (std.get("tooling_eur") or 0)) / sold * cash_now
  98         - ppm / 1e6 * ((t.get("chargeback_eur_per_complaint") or 0) - (std.get("chargeback_eur_per_complaint") or 0))
  99         + supplier.get("extra", 0.0)
 100     )
 101 
 102 
 103 def _soft(gap):
 104     """Margin points below the sustainable margin, as they cost: none above it, quadratic over
 105     the first 5 points, linear beyond - no kink."""
 106     if gap <= 0:
 107         return 0.0
 108     return gap * gap / 10 if gap <= 5 else gap - 2.5
 109 
 110 
 111 def relationship_cost(case, terms, standard=None, supplier=None, value=None):
 112     """Strategic and bottleneck goals only: EUR for every margin point the deal leaves the supplier
 113     below `sustainable_margin_pct`, per year covered. `supplier["full_cost"]` (EUR per unit) is your
 114     estimate of its full cost; `value` overrides `supplier_value`. Without an estimate: 0."""
 115     b = case["buyer"]
 116     per_point, sustainable = b.get("relationship_eur_per_point"), b.get("sustainable_margin_pct")
 117     if b.get("category_goal") not in RELATIONSHIP_GOALS or not per_point or not sustainable or not supplier:
 118         return 0.0
 119     t = closing_terms(case, terms, standard)
 120     worth = value if value is not None else supplier_value(case, t, supplier)
 121     margin = (worth - supplier["full_cost"]) / worth * 100
 122     return per_point * _soft(sustainable - margin) * _years(case, t)
 123 
 124 
 125 def cost_breakdown(case, terms, standard=None, supplier=None):
 126     """C by part. `standard`: the supplier's standard terms for anything the term sheet leaves out.
 127     `supplier`: your estimate of the supplier for the relationship term (`supplier_value`)."""
 128     b, t = case["buyer"], closing_terms(case, terms, standard)
 129     if t.get("unit_price") is None:
 130         raise ValueError("no unit_price: a term sheet without a price has no cost")
 131     years = _years(case, t)
 132     committed = t["volume_per_year"] * years  # bought, needed or not
 133     covered = min(t["volume_per_year"], b["need_per_year"]) * years
 134     pre = _units_before(case, t, years)
 135     at_new_price = (committed - pre) * t["unit_price"]
 136     spend = pre * (b.get("current_unit_price") or t["unit_price"]) + at_new_price
 137     per_defect = b.get("cost_per_defect", 0)
 138     defect_cost = per_defect - min(t.get("chargeback_eur_per_complaint") or 0, per_defect)
 139     index = index_risk = 0.0
 140     if clause := t.get("index_clause"):
 141         path = b.get("index_paths", {}).get(clause["series"], 0.0)
 142         moved = max(0.0, abs(path) - clause["deadband_pct"] / 100)
 143         index = at_new_price * clause["material_share"] * moved * math.copysign(1, path)
 144         index_risk = at_new_price * clause["material_share"] * b.get("index_risk_pct", 0) / 100
 145     uncovered = (b["need_per_year"] * b["horizon_years"] - covered) * b["fallback_unit_price"]
 146     need = b["need_lead_time_days"]
 147     return {
 148         "price": spend,
 149         "uncovered_need": uncovered,
 150         "fallback_risk": uncovered * b.get("fallback_risk_pct", 0) / 100,
 151         "payment_terms": spend * b["interest_rate"] * (b["reference_payment_days"] - t["payment_days"]) / 360,
 152         "freight": committed * b["freight_eur_per_unit"][t["incoterm"]],
 153         "late_delivery": b.get("late_cost_per_day", 0) * max(0, t["lead_time_days"] - need),
 154         "quality": committed * (t.get("ppm_commitment") or 0) / 1e6 * defect_cost,
 155         "tooling": t.get("tooling_eur") or 0.0,
 156         "index_clause": index,
 157         "index_risk": index_risk,
 158         "relationship": relationship_cost(case, t, supplier=supplier),
 159     }
 160 
 161 
 162 def total_cost(case, terms, standard=None, supplier=None):
 163     """C in EUR; infinite for terms without a price (e.g. a supplier that quotes none), so such a
 164     sheet is never the cheapest and never beats an alternative."""
 165     if closing_terms(case, terms, standard).get("unit_price") is None:
 166         return math.inf
 167     return round(sum(cost_breakdown(case, terms, standard, supplier).values()), 2)
 168 
 169 
 170 def score(c_open, c_deal, c_best):
 171     if c_deal is None:
 172         return 0.0
 173     if c_open - c_best <= 0.01:  # no room to negotiate: matching the best is full marks
 174         return 1.0 if c_deal <= c_best + 0.01 else 0.0
 175     return min(1.0, max(0.0, (c_open - c_deal) / (c_open - c_best)))
 176 
 177 
 178 def must_haves_ok(case, terms, standard=None):
 179     t = closing_terms(case, terms, standard)
 180     for m in case["buyer"].get("must_haves", []):
 181         value = t.get(m["field"])
 182         if value is None and m["op"] not in ("==", "!="):
 183             return False
 184         if not OPS[m["op"]](value, m["value"]):
 185             return False
 186     return True
 187 
 188 
 189 def snap(case, field, value):
 190     """The allowed value closest to `value` (case `term_options`), else `value` unchanged."""
 191     options = case.get("term_options", {}).get(field)
 192     if not options or value in options:
 193         return value
 194     if isinstance(value, int | float) and all(isinstance(o, int | float) for o in options):
 195         return min(options, key=lambda o: (abs(o - value), o))
 196     return options[0]
 197 
 198 
 199 def complete_offer(case, terms):
 200     """A valid term sheet: exactly the negotiable fields, gaps from the buyer's plan, snapped."""
 201     plan = closing_terms(case, {"unit_price": None})
 202     freight = case["buyer"]["freight_eur_per_unit"]
 203     plan["incoterm"] = min(freight, key=freight.get)  # when asking, ask for the cheapest freight
 204     out = {}
 205     for field in case["negotiable"]:
 206         value = terms.get(field, plan.get(field))
 207         if value is None and case.get("term_options", {}).get(field):
 208             value = case["term_options"][field][0]
 209         value = snap(case, field, value)
 210         out[field] = round(value, 2) if field == "unit_price" and value is not None else value
 211     return out

 162 def total_cost(case, terms, standard=None, supplier=None):
 163     """C in EUR; infinite for terms without a price (e.g. a supplier that quotes none), so such a
 164     sheet is never the cheapest and never beats an alternative."""
 165     if closing_terms(case, terms, standard).get("unit_price") is None:
 166         return math.inf
 167     return round(sum(cost_breakdown(case, terms, standard, supplier).values()), 2)

 170 def score(c_open, c_deal, c_best):
 171     if c_deal is None:
 172         return 0.0
 173     if c_open - c_best <= 0.01:  # no room to negotiate: matching the best is full marks
 174         return 1.0 if c_deal <= c_best + 0.01 else 0.0
 175     return min(1.0, max(0.0, (c_open - c_deal) / (c_open - c_best)))

 178 def must_haves_ok(case, terms, standard=None):
 179     t = closing_terms(case, terms, standard)
 180     for m in case["buyer"].get("must_haves", []):
 181         value = t.get(m["field"])
 182         if value is None and m["op"] not in ("==", "!="):
 183             return False
 184         if not OPS[m["op"]](value, m["value"]):

 189 def snap(case, field, value):
 190     """The allowed value closest to `value` (case `term_options`), else `value` unchanged."""
 191     options = case.get("term_options", {}).get(field)
 192     if not options or value in options:
 193         return value
 194     if isinstance(value, int | float) and all(isinstance(o, int | float) for o in options):
 195         return min(options, key=lambda o: (abs(o - value), o))
 196     return options[0]

 201     plan = closing_terms(case, {"unit_price": None})
 202     freight = case["buyer"]["freight_eur_per_unit"]
 203     plan["incoterm"] = min(freight, key=freight.get)  # when asking, ask for the cheapest freight
 204     out = {}

 208             value = case["term_options"][field][0]
 209         value = snap(case, field, value)
 210         out[field] = round(value, 2) if field == "unit_price" and value is not None else value

 226     for the next. Keep it running from before the first wave until the last has closed; it returns
 227     after `waves` waves have closed and every case has finished: {case_id: result or exception}."""
 228     started, closed, caps = {}, set(), {}  # caps: wave -> its cap as time.time()
 229 
 230     def one(case, deadline):
 231         try:
 232             return play(RemoteTable(client, case), case["case_id"], new_agent(), deadline)
 233         except Exception as e:  # one broken case must not stop the others
 234             log.exception("%s failed", case["case_id"])
 235             return e
 236 
 237     with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=parallel) as pool:
 238         while len(closed) < waves or not all(f.done() for f in started.values()):
 239             try:
 240                 cases = client.cases("final")
 241             except ArenaError as e:
 242                 if e.status != 403:  # 403: no wave has started yet
 243                     raise
 244                 cases = []
 245             for case in cases:
 246                 if not case.get("open"):
 247                     closed.add(case["wave"])
 248                     continue
 249                 if case.get("seconds_left") is not None:  # each wave has its own cap; follow an extension
 250                     caps[case["wave"]] = time.time() + case["seconds_left"]
 251                 if case["case_id"] not in started and case.get("seconds_left"):
 252                     if case["wave"] not in {c["wave"] for c in cases if c["case_id"] in started}:
 253                         log.warning("wave %s started: %s", case["wave"], case.get("theme"))
 254                     started[case["case_id"]] = pool.submit(one, case, functools.partial(caps.get, case["wave"]))
 255             time.sleep(poll)
 256     return {case_id: f.result() for case_id, f in started.items()}

1 """What the data says about a supplier before the first move: owner type, the persona traits in
   2 its notes, letters, quote remarks and news (the package and the Sunday release alike), and from
   3 those its cost of money. Unknown suppliers (not in the package, e.g. the sandbox) get the neutral
   4 profile; their own e-mails are scanned for the same traits as they arrive (`signals_in`)."""
   5 
   6 import re
   7 
   8 # One or two fixed phrases per trait in the generated texts, widened to the word forms seen across
   9 # the whole package (restructuring programme, lowered its rating, "nickel and alloys forward").
  10 SIGNALS = {
  11     "cash_need": r"pay earlier|bank is watching|cash and the banks|within 10 days|under pressure"
  12     r"|restructur\w*|short-time work|lower\w* (its |their )?rating|cash is tight|we like fast payers"
  13     r"|negotiat\w+ with (its|their) banks|lowers our margin|loss-making|liquidity|waiting for cash",
  14     "spare_capacity": r"second shift has been on hold|take additional parts|looks for new customers"
  15     r"|free (machine )?capacity|keep (the|our) machines (busy|running)",
  16     "capacity_full": r"order intake is very strong|binding 12-month commitment"
  17     r"|cannot confirm your full forecast|fully booked|allocat\w+ (volumes|in line)|factory is super busy"
  18     r"|high capacity utili[sz]ation|prioriti[sz]e customers with firm",
  19     "open_book": r"walk (us|you) through (their|our) calculation",
  20     "stale_costing": r"not followed (his|its|their) material|own spreadsheet",
  21     "partnership_2022": r"kept supplying at the old price",
  22     "reference_customer": r"important reference customer",
  23     "approval_2pct": r"above 2 ?% need the approval|pricing committee",
  24     "deprioritising_us": r"reviewing small accounts|not strategic|reorganising our range"
  25     r"|supply from stock only|sharpens its focus|focus on customers with volume",
  26     "price_frozen": r"no room on price|not discounted|price list applies to all|discounts not possible"
  27     r"|frozen all price reductions",
  28     "hedged": r"bought (their|our) [\w ,]{1,40} forward|covered at fixed prices|material covered until"
  29     r"|secures power prices|hedged",
  30     "complains_late_pay": r"invoices are overdue",
  31 }
  32 # Cost of money per year by owner type (seen in practice: groups 4 to 7 %, family firms 7 to 8.5 %,
  33 # founder-run job shops 12 to 17 %); a cash need adds to it.
  34 RATE = {"group": 0.05, "private": 0.07, "family": 0.075, "founder": 0.12}
  35 DEFAULT_RATE = 0.07
  36 
  37 
  38 def signals_in(text):
  39     return sorted(k for k, pat in SIGNALS.items() if re.search(pat, text or "", re.I))
  40 
  41 
  42 def supplier_texts(pkg, sid):
  43     """Every text about this supplier: its letters, call and meeting notes and news, from the
  44     package and the Sunday release (both reach `ids` and `document`), plus its quote remarks."""
  45     texts = []
  46     for ref in pkg.ids("doc:") + pkg.ids("news:"):
  47         row = pkg.lookup(ref) or {}
  48         if row.get("supplier") != sid and row.get("supplier_id") != sid:
  49             continue
  50         try:
  51             texts.append(pkg.document(ref))
  52         except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - a row without a readable file: its headline still counts
  53             texts.append(" ".join(str(v) for k, v in row.items() if k in ("title", "headline", "body", "subject")))
  54     try:
  55         texts += [r.get("remarks") or "" for r in pkg.query("SELECT remarks FROM quotes WHERE supplier_id = ?", (sid,))]
  56     except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - no SQLite
  57         pass
  58     return texts
  59 
  60 
  61 def profile(pkg, sid):
  62     """{owner_type, country, category, signals, rate, warm}; neutral when the package does not know it."""
  63     out = {"owner_type": None, "country": None, "category": None, "signals": [], "rate": DEFAULT_RATE, "warm": True}
  64     if pkg is None or not pkg.lookup(sid):
  65         return out
  66     try:
  67         sup = pkg.query("SELECT country, category, skonto_days, skonto_pct FROM suppliers WHERE id = ?", (sid,))
  68         intel = pkg.query("SELECT owner_type, staff FROM supplier_intel WHERE supplier_id = ?", (sid,))
  69     except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - no SQLite: neutral
  70         return out
  71     sig = signals_in("\n".join(supplier_texts(pkg, sid)))
  72     owner = intel[0]["owner_type"] if intel else None
  73     rate = RATE.get(owner, DEFAULT_RATE)
  74     if "cash_need" in sig:
  75         rate += 0.05
  76     if sup and sup[0].get("skonto_pct") and sup[0].get("skonto_days"):
  77         # a cash discount of s % for paying d days early is worth s / d * 360 % a year to it
  78         days_early = max(1, 30 - int(sup[0]["skonto_days"]))
  79         rate = max(rate, min(0.2, sup[0]["skonto_pct"] / 100 * 360 / max(days_early, 10) / 2))
  80     out.update(
  81         owner_type=owner,
  82         country=sup[0]["country"] if sup else None,
  83         category=sup[0]["category"] if sup else None,
  84         signals=sig,
  85         rate=round(rate, 3),
  86         warm=owner in (None, "family", "founder", "private"),
  87     )
  88     return out

1 """Read-only access to the data package: SQL, lookup by citable ID, documents, practice cases -
   2 plus the Sunday release (new news, letters and a memo) once you have downloaded it."""
   3 
   4 import csv
   5 import json
   6 import os
   7 import sqlite3
   8 from functools import cached_property
   9 from pathlib import Path
  10 
  11 MAX_ROWS = 200
  12 RELEASE = "release-sunday"
  13 
  14 
  15 class DataPackage:
  16     def __init__(self, root, release=None):
  17         """`root`: the unpacked package. `release`: the unpacked Sunday release (default: a
  18         `release-sunday` folder inside or next to the package, or ARENA_RELEASE), if present."""
  19         self.root = Path(root).expanduser().resolve()
  20         # facts.json holds every citable fact with the fields the arena checks claims against.
  21         own = self.root / "facts.json"
  22         facts = [own] if own.is_file() else [p for p in sorted(self.root.rglob("facts.json")) if RELEASE not in p.parts]
  23         self.facts = json.loads(facts[0].read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if facts else {}
  24         release = release or os.environ.get("ARENA_RELEASE")
  25         candidates = [Path(release).expanduser()] if release else [self.root / RELEASE, self.root.parent / RELEASE]
  26         self.release = next((p.resolve() for p in candidates if (p / "facts.json").is_file()), None)
  27         if self.release:  # new IDs only: nothing in the package changes
  28             self.facts |= json.loads((self.release / "facts.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
  29         dbs = sorted(self.root.rglob("*.sqlite")) + sorted(self.root.rglob("*.db"))
  30         if not dbs and not facts:
  31             raise FileNotFoundError(f"no facts.json or .sqlite under {self.root}")
  32         self.db = None
  33         if dbs:
  34             self.db = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{dbs[0]}?mode=ro", uri=True, check_same_thread=False)
  35             self.db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
  36             self.db.execute("PRAGMA query_only = ON")
  37 
  38     def tables(self):
  39         """{table: {"columns": [...], "rows": n}}"""
  40         if self.db is None:
  41             return {}
  42         names = [r[0] for r in self.db.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' ORDER BY name")]
  43         return {
  44             t: {
  45                 "columns": [f"{c[1]} {c[2]}".strip() for c in self.db.execute(f'PRAGMA table_info("{t}")')],
  46                 "rows": self.db.execute(f'SELECT count(*) FROM "{t}"').fetchone()[0],
  47             }
  48             for t in names
  49         }
  50 
  51     def query(self, sql, params=(), limit=MAX_ROWS):
  52         if self.db is None:
  53             raise ValueError("this package has no SQLite file")
  54         if sql.lstrip().split(None, 1)[0].lower() not in {"select", "with"}:
  55             raise ValueError("read-only: SELECT or WITH statements only")
  56         cur = self.db.execute(sql, params)
  57         return [dict(r) for r in cur.fetchmany(limit)]
  58 
  59     @cached_property
  60     def _ids(self):
  61         # A table's citable ID sits in its `id` column, else in its first column.
  62         index = {}
  63         for t, meta in self.tables().items():
  64             cols = [c.split()[0] for c in meta["columns"]]
  65             key = "id" if "id" in cols else cols[0]
  66             for row in self.db.execute(f'SELECT * FROM "{t}"'):
  67                 value = row[key]
  68                 if isinstance(value, str) and ":" in value:
  69                     index[value] = {"table": t, **dict(row)}
  70         for path in sorted(self.release.glob("data/*.csv")) if self.release else []:  # not in the SQLite
  71             with path.open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
  72                 for row in csv.DictReader(f):
  73                     index[row["id"]] = {"table": path.stem, **row, "root": str(self.release)}
  74         return index
  75 
  76     def lookup(self, ref):
  77         """The fact behind a citable ID (from facts.json, else its table row), or None."""
  78         return self.facts.get(ref) or self._ids.get(ref)
  79 
  80     def ids(self, prefix):
  81         """All citable IDs starting with `prefix`, sorted, e.g. ids("idx:GP19-245113@")."""
  82         return sorted(i for i in self.facts.keys() | self._ids.keys() if i.startswith(prefix))
  83 
  84     def document(self, ref):
  85         """A document's text by ID (row with a path or body column) or by path in the package."""
  86         row, base = self._ids.get(ref) or self.facts.get(ref), self.root
  87         if row:
  88             for col in ("body", "text", "content"):
  89                 if row.get(col):
  90                     return row[col]
  91             base = Path(row.get("root") or self.root)
  92             ref = next((row[c] for c in ("path", "file") if row.get(c)), None)
  93             if ref is None:
  94                 return json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False)
  95         path = (base / ref).resolve()
  96         if not path.is_relative_to(base) or not path.is_file():
  97             raise FileNotFoundError(ref)
  98         return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
  99 
 100     @cached_property
 101     def cases(self):
 102         """Practice (and demo) case files in the package: {case_id: case}."""
 103         out = {}
 104         for p in sorted(self.root.rglob("cases/**/*.json")):
 105             case = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
 106             if isinstance(case, dict) and "case_id" in case:
 107                 out[case["case_id"]] = case
 108         return out

"""An LLM buyer that negotiates by e-mail: the model reads, argues and writes; code does numbers.

Code prepares the case, the letter that started it, the data rows the case points to, the cost C
of every standing term sheet (with the standard terms read from the supplier's quote PDF) and the
text of every attached document. The model writes the e-mail - arguments with data IDs included -
and proposes up to three term sheets. Code completes and snaps the term sheets, removes data IDs
that do not exist (an unknown ID costs trust), and refuses an accept that breaks a must-have or
loses to the alternative. Finding the data that moves a supplier is left to you: this agent only
sees what the case points to. Any provider works: pass `complete(system, user) -> str`, or use
`llm_from_env()`.
"""

import json
import logging
import math
import os
import re

import httpx

from ..cost import complete_offer, must_haves_ok, total_cost
from ..docs import standard_terms
from ..play import latest, live_threads, moves_left, standing
from .naive import NaiveAgent

log = logging.getLogger("arena")
ID_RE = re.compile(r"\b(?:idx|quote|offer|sc|qn|po|cost|fc|news|doc|ctr):[\w.:@#/-]*\w")

SYSTEM = """You are the buyer agent of Hollerau Pumpenwerke, a German pump maker, negotiating with
industrial suppliers by e-mail. Goal: the lowest total cost C in euros for covering the need in the
case file, without breaking a must-have. C of every standing term sheet is computed for you.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"supplier_id": "...", "action": "send", "subject": "...", "body": "...",
 "term_sheets": [{"unit_price": 0.0, "...": "..."}]}
{"supplier_id": "...", "action": "accept"}      (takes that supplier's standing term sheet)
{"supplier_id": "...", "action": "walk_away"}   (ends the case without a deal)

- term_sheets: 0-3 alternative packages over the negotiable fields. Only term sheets bind.
- Arguments need data: cite the ID from FACTS and its figure in the same sentence, one argument
  per sentence. The supplier checks the figure; a wrong one or an unknown ID costs trust.
- The supplier's team reads your e-mail as a person would. Ask questions (a cost breakdown, the
  earliest lead time, cheaper variants). Never reveal urgency, a budget or a missing alternative.
  Stay polite and factual.
- Whatever a term sheet leaves out closes on the supplier's standard terms (its quote PDF).
- The case's category_goal sets its rates. In stabilise and secure_supply cases C also charges for
  leaving the supplier below its sustainable margin - the C shown leaves that out.
- Do not accept the first offer. Concede in small steps; trade what is cheap for you (payment
  days, contract length, volume, dates). status final_offer: push further and it may walk.
- Accept only a term sheet that beats your alternative. Body: a short business e-mail, at most
  120 words, no placeholders."""


def llm_from_env():
    """LLM_PROVIDER=anthropic (Anthropic SDK) or openai (any OpenAI-compatible endpoint)."""
    provider, model = os.environ.get("LLM_PROVIDER", "openai"), os.environ["LLM_MODEL"]
    if provider == "anthropic":
        import anthropic

        client = anthropic.Anthropic(timeout=45.0)
        extra = {"output_config": {"effort": e}} if (e := os.environ.get("LLM_EFFORT")) else {}

        def complete(system, user):
            r = client.messages.create(
                model=model,
                max_tokens=16000,
                system=system,
                messages=[{"role": "user", "content": user}],
                **extra,
            )
            return "".join(b.text for b in r.content if b.type == "text")

        return complete
    base = os.environ.get("LLM_BASE_URL", "https://api.openai.com/v1").rstrip("/")
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('LLM_API_KEY', '')}"}

    def complete(system, user):
        body = {
            "model": model,
            "messages": [{"role": "system", "content": system}, {"role": "user", "content": user}],
        }
        r = httpx.post(f"{base}/chat/completions", json=body, headers=headers, timeout=45.0)
        r.raise_for_status()
        return r.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]

    return complete


class LLMAgent:
    def __init__(self, complete, package=None):
        self.complete, self.package = complete, package
        self.fallback = NaiveAgent()
        self.case_id, self.brief = None, ""

    def decide(self, case, threads):
        if case["case_id"] != self.case_id:
            self.case_id, self.brief = case["case_id"], self.prepare(case)
        try:
            reply = self.complete(SYSTEM, self.render(case, threads))
            checked = self.guard(case, threads, parse(reply))

1 """The Live Final loop end to end on arena-sim: waves appear one after another in the case list,
   2 every case of a wave plays within its cap, a poll error is polled again, and the loop ends when
   3 the last wave has closed. No network, no model."""
   4 
   5 import secrets
   6 import socket
   7 import threading
   8 import time
   9 
  10 import pytest
  11 import uvicorn
  12 from arena_kit import ArenaClient
  13 from arena_kit.client import ArenaError
  14 from arena_kit.sim import Sim, create_app, load_cases
  15 
  16 from buyer import runner
  17 
  18 
  19 class FinalClient(ArenaClient):
  20     """The sim's client with a scripted final: `cases("final")` is 403 before the first wave, then
  21     lists each wave's cases as open with seconds left, then as closed; one poll fails outright."""
  22 
  23     def __init__(self, url, key, waves):
  24         super().__init__(url, key, rate=1000)
  25         self.waves, self.polls = waves, 0
  26 
  27     def cases(self, set_="practice"):
  28         if set_ != "final":
  29             return super().cases(set_)
  30         self.polls += 1
  31         if self.polls == 1:
  32             raise ArenaError(403, "the final has not started")
  33         if self.polls == 3:
  34             raise ArenaError(500, "a hiccup")
  35         step = 1 + (self.polls - 2) // 2  # a new wave every second poll; one past the last closes it
  36         out = []
  37         for w, ids in enumerate(self.waves, start=1):
  38             if w > step:
  39                 continue
  40             open_ = w == step
  41             for cid in ids:
  42                 out.append({"case_id": cid, "wave": w, "open": open_, "seconds_left": 480 if open_ else 0})
  43         return out
  44 
  45

1 """The Live Final loop end to end on arena-sim: waves appear one after another in the case list,
   2 every case of a wave plays within its cap, a poll error is polled again, and the loop ends when
   3 the last wave has closed. No network, no model."""
   4 
   5 import secrets
   6 import socket
   7 import threading
   8 import time
   9 
  10 import pytest
  11 import uvicorn
  12 from arena_kit import ArenaClient

  15

  17

  19 class FinalClient(ArenaClient):
  20     """The sim's client with a scripted final: `cases("final")` is 403 before the first wave, then
  21     lists each wave's cases as open with seconds left, then as closed; one poll fails outright."""
  22 
  23     def __init__(self, url, key, waves):
  24         super().__init__(url, key, rate=1000)
  25         self.waves, self.polls = waves, 0
  26 
  27     def cases(self, set_="practice"):
  28         if set_ != "final":
  29             return super().cases(set_)
  30         self.polls += 1
  31         if self.polls == 1:
  32             raise ArenaError(403, "the final has not started")
  33         if self.polls == 3:
  34             raise ArenaError(500, "a hiccup")
  35         step = 1 + (self.polls - 2) // 2  # a new wave every second poll; one past the last closes it
  36         out = []
  37         for w, ids in enumerate(self.waves, start=1):
  38             if w > step:
  39                 continue
  40             open_ = w == step
  41             for cid in ids:
  42                 out.append({"case_id": cid, "wave": w, "open": open_, "seconds_left": 480 if open_ else 0})
  43         return out
  44

  48     sim = Sim(load_cases(), clock=lambda: 1_000_000.0)
  49     with socket.socket() as s:
  50         s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
  51         port = s.getsockname()[1]
  52     server = uvicorn.Server(uvicorn.Config(create_app(sim), port=port, log_level="warning"))
  53     thread = threading.Thread(target=server.run, daemon=True)
  54     thread.start()
  55     while not server.started:
  56         time.sleep(0.01)
  57     yield f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}"
  58     server.should_exit = True
  59     thread.join()
  60

Audit of /Users/stef/Projects/ehlcodacabana-final (read-only; nothing edited). Verified: `uv run pytest -q` = 35 passed in 19.8s. `uv run ruff check .` = All checks passed. `uv run ruff check . --select F401,F841,ARG` = 19 hits (only ARG; no F401/F841 anywhere). `uv run --with vulture vulture buyer tests --min-confidence 60` = 6 hits, 1 real. Working tree also shows logs/sessions/**/.DS_Store as deleted (unrelated to this audit).

1. UNUSED CODE
- buyer/claims.py:10 `ID_RE`: zero references (name count 1; vulture 60%). Delete. High.
- buyer/economics.py:170-175 `score()`: zero callers in buyer/, tests/, analysis/. Body is identical to arena_kit.cost.score (cost.py:170). Delete. High.
- Unused parameters (ruff ARG, confirmed in body):
  - buyer/claims.py:130 `notice(self, sid)`: sid unused; call at claims.py:307. Drop param. High.
  - buyer/economics.py:63 `clause_value(case, terms, est)`: case unused; call at economics.py:110. Drop param. High.
  - buyer/economics.py:174 `at_price(case, terms, price)`: case unused; 11 call sites (policy.py:127,177,179,257,260,287,299,342,347,550; economics.py:187). Drop param, mechanical edit. High.
  - buyer/policy.py:415 `facts(self, s, sheets, ...)`: sheets unused; call at policy.py:506. Drop param. High.
- Unused imports: none in buyer/ (ruff F401 clean).
- Other buyer module constants and defs each have 2+ references (checked all top-level names across buyer/, tests/, analysis/).
- Not buyer, noted: analysis/explore.py:148 `docs` unused arg.
- Vulture false positives, keep: tests/test_buyer.py:33, tests/test_cases.py:47, tests/test_waves.py:58 `server.should_exit` (uvicorn attribute).

2. TINY MODULES
- buyer/agent.py (20 lines): AGENTS (used only by cli.py:55,59 choices), load_package (only caller cli.py:78), naive_factory() which just returns the NaiveAgent class (used as naive_factory()() at cli.py:84 and as factory at cli.py:96,107). Action: delete naive_factory and use NaiveAgent directly (arena_kit play_all calls new_agent(), so the class works as the factory); move AGENTS and load_package into cli.py; delete agent.py. High.
- buyer/reader.py (25 lines): ASKS + asks(body). Only importer policy.py:24; only use policy.py:330; comment policy.py:68. Action: merge into policy.py. Medium-high.
- policy.py:642 `deadline_near`: used only by runner.py:19,69. Move to runner.py. Medium.
- buyer/__init__.py: docstring only, keep.

3. REIMPLEMENTS ARENA_KIT
- policy.py:40 `ENDED = {"walked_away", "no_bid"}`: duplicates arena_kit.play.ENDED (play.py:24). runner.py:16 already imports it from arena_kit. Replace with the import. High.
- economics.py:10 `RELATIONSHIP_GOALS`: identical to arena_kit.cost.RELATIONSHIP_GOALS (cost.py:16). Import it. High.
- policy.py:603 `live = [sid for sid, ev in threads.items() if latest(ev).get("status") not in ENDED] or list(threads)`: replace with `live_threads(threads) or list(threads)` (play.py:108). Same check at policy.py:588 and runner.py:64-67 (`live()`). Medium-high.
- policy.py:582-607 `best_offer` + `close` vs arena_kit.play.closing_move (play.py:126-139): same idea (cheapest standing sheet that keeps must-haves and beats the alternative, else walk away). Not a drop-in: closing_move uses total_cost without the supplier estimate, so it drops the relationship charge that economics.deal_cost keeps (tested in test_guards.py:47). Keep. Low.
- runner.py:156 `keep = (...)` tuple: same as arena_kit.cli.summary (cli.py:44-46), except summary omits missing keys. Replace with `summary(result)`. Low-medium.
- runner.py:162-181 `play_all` and runner.py:184-218 `play_waves`: duplicate arena_kit.play.play_all (play.py:196-221) and play_waves (play.py:224-256). The arena versions hardwire `play`, so they cannot take play_case. Keep; ~50 duplicated lines. Low.
- buyer/claims.py:226-227 signal_notes reads `self.pkg.root / d.file` by hand. Replace with `self.pkg.document(d["id"])` (arena_kit/data.py:84-98: resolves by ID and the `file` column, with a path-containment check). Catch FileNotFoundError to keep the empty-text fallback. Medium.
- buyer/llm.py:44-62 `complete_from_env`: reimplements the OpenAI branch of arena_kit.agents.llm.llm_from_env (agents/llm.py:54-86). Differences: buyer adds reasoning_effort to the body, returns None when unconfigured, and has no anthropic branch. Keep only if reasoning_effort is required; otherwise replace. Medium-low.
- buyer/economics.py:24-29 `c_alt`: same expression as closing_move's c_alt (play.py:130), with the estimate-aware cost() wrapper. Low.
- No drop-in exists for writer.describe (writer.py:23-34) or economics.plan_terms/options/relationship_optimum.

4. OBSOLETE PATHS / FLAGS
- buyer/cli.py:63 `--cases`: read only in the practice/sandbox branch (cli.py:103-104). With `--set final` it is silently ignored. Reject it there or document. Medium.
- buyer/runner.py:41 `getattr(table, "done", None)`: RemoteTable always sets `done` (arena_kit/play.py:40), so the default is defensive noise. Low.
- cli.py:67 `getattr(args, "no_llm", False)` is needed (SUPPRESS default), not dead.
- policy.py:543 `fallback_move` is live (runner.py:96).
- No TODO, FIXME, XXX, commented-out code, or compat shim found in buyer/, tests/, analysis/ (grep).

5. DUPLICATED LOGIC
- Signal detection runs twice: claims.py:228 (hedged regex) and claims.py:238 (open_book regex) re-scan every supplier document. personas.py:19 and :28-29 define the same two traits, and personas.profile (personas.py:71) already scans the same texts into s.prof["signals"]. Action: in signal_notes, call personas.signals_in(text) (personas.py:38) instead of the second pair of regexes. Medium-high.
